output_text:
```python
import os
from azure.keyvault.keys import KeyClient
from azure.keyvault.keys.crypto import CryptoClient
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

def envelope_encrypt(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    key_vault_name = config.get("KEY_VAULT_NAME", os.environ["KEY_VAULT_NAME"])
    key_name = config.get("KEY_NAME", os.environ["KEY_NAME"])
    
    credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
    key_client = KeyClient(vault_url=f"https://{key_vault_name}.vault.azure.net", credential=credential)
    crypto_client = CryptoClient(vault_url=f"https://{key_vault_name}.vault.azure.net", credential=credential)
    
    key = key_client.get_key(key_name)
    encrypt_result = crypto_client.encrypt(key.name, "RSA_OAEP", payload)
    
    result = {
        "key_id": key.id,
        "encrypted_data": encrypt_result.ciphertext
    }
    return result
```
